title: The Ninth-Grade Xuan Dan
summary: The final round of the Pill Gathering pits Xiao Yan against Yao Wanhuo, Old Shennong and Hun Xuzi. Yao Wanhuo shows the Nine Nether Wind Flame, Old Shennong the Flame of Life, and Hun Xuzi a sub-flame of the Void Devouring Flame, while Xiao Yan refines over a thousand herbs at once with the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame and Xiao Yi. All four try for a ninth-grade Xuan Dan by drawing on the energy of heaven and earth, and soon drain everything within a thousand miles. Hun Xuzi then uses his flame to steal the others' energy, but Xiao Yi purifies it, Xiao Yan's puppet traps him, and Yao Wanhuo and Old Shennong fight him. With their own pills ruined, the two elders give their nascent pills to Xiao Yan, and the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame turns the mixed ingredients into pure energy. His Xuan Dan survives its lightning tribulation and even takes human form to try to escape, and Xiao Yan is named the continent's number one alchemist. Yao Dan grants Yao Lao's wish for the clan monument, and then Hun Xuzi demands the Medicine Clan's Tuoshe Ancient Emperor Jade and announces that the clan is about to disappear.
